description: This file appears to be a Makefile used for managing package feeds in a Linux build system, particularly related to OpenWrt/LEDE project. It includes variable definitions, directory structures, and shell commands for handling package sources, feed configurations, and ABI suffix formatting.

methods.name: FeedPackageDir
methods.description: Determines the directory path for a given package feed, considering per-feed repository configuration.

methods.name: FeedSourcesAppendOPKG
methods.description: Creates feed source entries for opkg package manager in a shell script format.

methods.name: FeedSourcesAppendAPK
methods.description: Creates feed source entries for apk package manager in a shell script format.

methods.name: GetABISuffix
methods.description: Generates an ABI suffix for a package based on package info and version.

methods.name: FormatABISuffix
methods.description: Formats the ABI suffix string based on version information.
